name: UFACTORY xArm 6 plate arm
status_line: In PyLabRobot (XArm6). It wraps the maker's published Python SDK, so there is no wire to decode.
reaches: Ethernet to the xArm controller through xarm-python-sdk (docs/user_guide/ufactory/xarm6/hello-world.ipynb:12). XArmAPI(ip) is created in setup(), then each operation is 1 blocking SDK call run in a thread (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:86).
decoded_from: Nothing decoded. The driver calls the maker's SDK (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:120-122) and checks only its return code (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:60-95). The registry lists it as status basic (docs/_static/devices.json:2132).
steps: Install the optional SDK extra: pip install PyLabRobot[xarm] (docs/user_guide/ufactory/xarm6/hello-world.ipynb:12).
Create XArm6(ip=..., tcp_offset=...) with the controller IP and your gripper mount offset, then await setup().
Teach the hotel and reader poses: start_freedrive_mode(free_axes=[0]), request_gripper_pose(), stop_freedrive_mode() (docs/user_guide/ufactory/xarm6/hello-world.ipynb:282).
Open with move_gripper(width=max_gripper_width). The driver's default jaw range is 71 to 150 mm (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:41-42): set it to your gripper.
Wrap pick_up_at_location and drop_at_location with your own above-pose moves; they only move and grip (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:270-271).
Put a timeout around each call and check the plate yourself; the driver reports no plate-held state.
scenario: Carry 1 plate from a hotel nest to the reader nest: above pick, open, descend, close, lift, above place, descend, open, retreat. All poses are made up.
real: Every SDK call and argument it makes
simulated: The XArmAPI object: pose, jaws, error and state codes
The SDK return codes, copied from xarm-python-sdk 1.18.4
not_checked: Real move times and a sane timeout (TODO_1)
Whether the gripper moves while the arm is in an error state
limits: A return code of 0 or None is success: _call_sdk never reads the arm error_code or state (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:91). For non-move calls the SDK maps codes 1, 2 and 9 to 0 (xarm-python-sdk xarm/x3/base.py:2179).
A grip width outside the range is clamped to it with no error, 71 to 150 mm by default (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:149-152).
No plate-held query. is_gripper_closed() only compares the reported width to 73 mm by default (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:185-188 and pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:43).
move_gohome is retried once after clear_errors (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:205-212); moves are not retried (pylabrobot/ufactory/xarm6/xarm6.py:239-251).
